row:
Hi and welcome to Equine Vet Life! 🐴✨ New videos weekly!

We are Dr. Jenna Donaldson, DVM and Sean Chin (her husband & filmmaker) from Southern Ontario, Canada 🇨🇦

This channel is a behind-the-scenes look at real equine veterinary life. Farm calls, diagnostics, problem-solving, and the everyday adventure that comes with it. No scripts, just real cases and real moments.

Come along for the ride and we hope you learn something new. 🐎❤️
